status: post-diagnostic rule frozen before exact clock-plus-cadence candidate counts
known_diagnostics: Same-CID count/clock checks, unique cadence assignment, and exploratory clock+count+cadence and per-row-CHI2 candidate diagnostics had already been inspected. Those do not define or repair this join.
scope: All 500 LCPLOT groups against all 30000 nominal NIR FITRES rows; no fits, no scientific timing or distance scores.
clock: Median MJD-Tobs of DATAFLAG=0 rows, which must have zero within-group spread; candidate FITRES PKMJD difference <=0.0056 observer days.
cadence: Each DATAFLAG=1 row must admit a distinct same-band SIMLIB S epoch within0.0056 day; exactly one compatible LIBID required. Candidate FITRES SIM_LIBID must equal that uniquely identified cadence. No missing-row rejection assumptions.
outputs: original CID membership in candidate set
interpretation: Metadata compatibility only, not an event identity certificate or execution linkage. Never choose a permutation from these candidates. Unidentified cadence remains unknown. No baseline gate widening.
